baseline.name: Enumerate all buy-before-sell pairs
baseline.approach: Evaluate every i<j trade and retain the largest nonnegative profit.

why: The best purchase price for a sale day is summarized by the minimum of the earlier prefix.
quantitative_comparison: A complete pair enumeration evaluates n(n-1)/2 candidate trades; the scan processes n-1 later days. For n>=2 those candidate/scan counts differ by n/2, but the steps are different operations and this is not an n/2 elapsed-time claim.
tradeoffs: Both use constant auxiliary space. The scan depends on valid bounded prices for its int arithmetic and supplies only the profit, not the chosen days.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
